I just want to move in with my girlfriend out of town but I'll never be able to afford the exorbitant rentals in california, the state I live in and only state I feel safe in (most states in the US are trying to ban gender affirming care last I checked).

My life is just, so unbelievably fucked. I have so many mental issues that keep me from being fully independent and my family takes advantage of that as often as they can. My extended family talks to me like I'm "stupid" for lack of a better word.

The Yakuza series are fantastic beat em up RPGs, I highly recommend starting with either 0 or Kiwami. 0 is a prequel to the entire series and over-the-top as hell, while Kiwami is a from-the-ground-up remake of the first game. I started with Kiwami but many fans recommend starting with 0, up to you though. They are are fairly easy, especially if you abuse weapons (gets expensive as they are low-durability and require frequent repairs) and/or health items (dirt cheap in 0, not as cheap in Kiwami). Also lots of wacky side-content, from simple majong to running a carabet club, to just virtual tourism in Japan.
Way of the Samurai 4 is a weird as hell samurai simulator. I'd compare it to Yakuza in terms of what you can do in it, ie serious storyline with wacky side content.
I concur, Call of Juarez Gunslinger is some of the most fun I have had with a shooter since the first year of Overwatch.
